samples.stimulus: A scatterplot of 10 observations relates the price of a ticket to the number of tickets sold. The line of best fit shown was computed from all 10 points, including one outlier.
samples.question: If the outlier is removed, which of the following is true about the new line of best fit?
options: The slope of the line of best fit would decrease, and the data would fit the line more closely.
The slope of the line of best fit would increase, and the data would fit the line less closely.
The slope of the line of best fit would decrease, and the data would fit the line less closely.
The slope of the line of best fit would increase, and the data would fit the line more closely.
samples.answer: The slope of the line of best fit would increase, and the data would fit the line more closely.
samples.explanation: (1) 그림에서 이상치(추세선에서 가장 먼 점)를 찾는다. (2) 이상치가 추세선보다 아래에 있고 오른쪽 끝이라 기울기를 줄인다. (3) 이상치를 빼면 기울기는 커진다. (4) 나머지 점은 직선에 더 가깝게 놓인다(상관이 강해진다). (5) 따라서 두 가지를 모두 맞게 말한 서술이 정답이다. 따라서 정답은 D이다.

samples.stimulus: Graph A and Graph B each show data on the number of days since a loaf was baked and the loaf's freshness score for 10 data points, with the line of best fit for all 10 points. Each graph has one outlier.
samples.question: Removing the outlier from which graph would change its line of best fit's slope more?
options: It cannot be determined from the graphs.
Graph A changes more, because its outlier is closer to the middle.
The slope changes by the same amount in both graphs.
Graph B changes more, because its outlier is at the far end of the x-values.
samples.answer: Graph B changes more, because its outlier is at the far end of the x-values.
samples.explanation: (1) 각 그래프에서 추세선에서 가장 먼 점을 이상치로 찾는다. (2) Graph B 의 이상치는 x 의 오른쪽 끝에, Graph A 의 이상치는 가운데에 있다. (3) x 의 끝에 있는 점은 기울기에 지렛대처럼 작용해 더 크게 끈다. (4) 이상치가 벗어난 정도는 같으므로 x 위치가 영향을 가른다. (5) 따라서 Graph B 이다. 따라서 정답은 D이다.
